description: lub is not associative (SPEC-GAPS §4): an n-ary match over List/Vector/Set differs from the left-nested if over the same branches.

termTypes.name: nary
termTypes.expr: i match { case 0 => List(1); case 1 => Vector(2); case _ => Set(3) }

termTypes.name: foldLeft
termTypes.expr: if (c1) (if (c2) List(1) else Vector(2)) else Set(3)

termTypes.name: foldRight
termTypes.expr: if (c1) List(1) else (if (c2) Vector(2) else Set(3))
